mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", resource_key AS "resourceKey", display_name AS "displayName", default_initial_value AS "defaultInitialValue", default_max_value AS "defaultMaxValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.resource_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY resource_key

SELECT game_id AS "gameId", resource_key AS "resourceKey", display_name AS "displayName", default_initial_value AS "defaultInitialValue", default_max_value AS "defaultMaxValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.resource_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND resource_key = #{resourceKey}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.resource_definitions (game_id, resource_key, display_name, default_initial_value, default_max_value, change_revision, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{resourceKey}, #{displayName}, #{defaultInitialValue}, #{defaultMaxValue}, #{changeRevision}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, resource_key) DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, default_initial_value = EXCLUDED.default_initial_value, default_max_value = EXCLUDED.default_max_value, change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT game_id AS "gameId", resource_key AS "resourceKey", display_name AS "displayName", default_initial_value AS "defaultInitialValue", default_max_value AS "defaultMaxValue", change_revision AS "changeRevision", updated_at AS "updatedAt" FROM public.resource_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ORDER BY change_revision, resource_key
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.resource_definitions_log ( game_id, version_id, change_revision, resource_key, display_name, default_initial_value, default_max_value ) SELECT game_id, #{versionId}, change_revision, resource_key, display_name, default_initial_value, default_max_value FROM public.resource_definitions WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND change_revision > #{previousRevision} AND change_revision <= #{publishRevision} ON CONFLICT (game_id, resource_key, version_id) DO UPDATE SET change_revision = EXCLUDED.change_revision, display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, default_initial_value = EXCLUDED.default_initial_value, default_max_value = EXCLUDED.default_max_value
